method: Initial direct inspection of 104 pages through 26 contact sheets, followed by direct full-page inspection of the six changed/new final pages 31, 51 and 102–105. Exact byte hashes carry the other 99 page inspections forward. Visual layout review remains separate from mathematical, source-correspondence and compiler audits.
result: PASS with one nonblocking cosmetic note

cosmetic_findings.description: Cosmetic only: chapter title breaks the word budgets across two lines; readable, no clipping. Root notified; shorter heading optional.

scope_notes: Sparse chapter-ending pages preserve chapter-start pagination and are not evidence of missing content.
Dense mathematics, decimal certificates, code paths, bibliography URLs and correspondence table paths fit.
The bibliographic version/access changes and two scalar-attribution changes were inspected in the final PDF.
No PDF rendering/editing occurred in this visual review. A later rebuild requires hash reconciliation and review of changed images.
